name: @formmaps/scripts
//: Scoped to scripts/ only. These are standalone Node >=22 tools run directly with native TypeScript type stripping (`node scripts/<name>.ts`) -- they are not part of the apps/web workspace and are not bundled. Without this file Node reparses each script as ESM and prints MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON, and tsc treats `import.meta` as a CommonJS error. Deliberately NOT set on the root package.json, which would change module resolution for the whole repo.
